description: A direct cash transfer scheme providing seasonal financial assistance to landowning farmers to purchase critical agricultural inputs.
benefits: Direct cash transfer of ₹6,000 per acre per season (total ₹12,000/acre annually) deposited into bank accounts via DBT.
eligibility: Pattadar landowning farmers recorded in the official Dharani land management system of Telangana
application_mode: Automated DBT based on Dharani Database / Agriculture Officer Verification

description: A fully state-funded direct benefit life insurance scheme providing immediate financial support to families of deceased farmers.
benefits: ₹5,00,000 life insurance payout delivered to the nominee within 10 days in case of natural or accidental death of the farmer.
eligibility: Pattadar landholding farmers in Telangana aged 18 to 59 years recorded in Dharani

description: Provides round-the-clock free electrical power to agricultural pump sets, eliminating energy costs for farming operations.
benefits: 100% free, 24x7 high-quality electricity supply for agricultural pump sets.
eligibility: All agricultural electricity connection holders and pump set operators in Telangana
application_mode: Offline via TSSPDCL / TSNPDCL Local Discom Office

scheme_name: Rythu Runa Mafi (Crop Loan Waiver Scheme)
description: Relieves agricultural debt distress by waiving outstanding short-term crop loans disbursed by institutional banks.
benefits: Complete waiver of short-term institutional crop loans up to ₹2,00,000 per farmer family.
eligibility: Farmers holding short-term crop loans from commercial or cooperative banks meeting state cutoff criteria
documents: Crop Loan Account Details / Bank Passbook
application_mode: Direct Bank Settlement based on Department Verification Portal

description: Subsidizes micro-irrigation installations to maximize crop yield per drop of water across semi-arid zones.
benefits: 100% subsidy for SC/ST farmers, 90% for small/marginal farmers, and 80% for general categories on drip and sprinkler setups.
eligibility: Farmers in Telangana owning land with an assured water source (borewell or canal)

description: Develops fallow lands of tribal farmers by fully funding water source extraction, power connectivity, and motor installation.
benefits: 100% state-funded drilling of borewells, installation of motor pumpsets, and power line extension for tribal agricultural lands.
eligibility: Small and marginal ST (Scheduled Tribe) farmers possessing RoFR or Pattadar passbooks in ITDA areas
application_mode: Offline via Integrated Tribal Development Agency (ITDA) / AEO

scheme_name: Sunna Vaddi Crop Loan Scheme (0% Interest Crop Loans)
description: Incentivizes timely bank loan repayment by reimbursing complete interest charges on short-term agricultural credit.
benefits: 100% interest subvention (0% effective interest rate) on crop loans up to ₹1,00,000 repaid within due dates.
eligibility: Farmers in Telangana who clear their short-term crop loans within the stipulated schedule
application_mode: Automatic Credit Transfer via Bank Branch

description: Encourages farmers to shift from paddy to oil palm cultivation to boost domestic edible oil production.
benefits: Up to 50%–70% financial subsidy on plant saplings, drip irrigation integration, inter-cropping support, and 4-year maintenance grants.
eligibility: Farmers in designated oil palm cultivation districts with guaranteed micro-irrigation facilities

description: Assists farmers and Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) in acquiring machinery to modernize land preparation, planting, and harvesting.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy on mini-tractors, paddy transplanters, rotavators, and combine harvesters.
eligibility: Individual farmers, CHCs, and farm worker groups registered in Telangana
application_mode: Online via Agritrans / Agri Department Portal

description: Promotes economic self-reliance among traditional shepherd communities by subsidizing high-quality sheep units.
benefits: 75% state subsidy on sheep units (20 ewes + 1 ram) including free veterinary health cover and feed support.
eligibility: Members of Primary Sheep Cooperative Societies (PSCS) aged 18 and above in Telangana
application_mode: Offline via District Animal Husbandry Officer / PSCS
